subject: ss-haematology
title: Myelodysplastic syndromes risk and treatment
refs: Harrison Principles of Internal Medicine 22e Ch 107 Bone Marrow Failure Syndromes

steps.tx: **Myelodysplastic syndromes** (MDS, clonal marrow dysplasias) are clonal precursor disorders with ineffective production, dysplastic maturation and blast excess. Most patients present after age **60** with **anaemia** (low red cells) as the commonest cytopenia. **Blast percentage** (immature cells) below **20** percent separates MDS from leukaemia, while **MDS with low blasts** and **MDS with excess blasts** frame the WHO spectrum. **Cytogenetic** (chromosome) abnormalities clinch clonality.
steps.say: Myelodysplastic syndromes are clonal marrow disorders with ineffective production. Anaemia is the commonest presentation in older adults. Blasts below twenty percent separate MDS from leukaemia.

steps.tx: **IPSS** (International Prognostic Scoring System) scores blasts, cytogenetics and cytopenias, while **IPSS M** (molecular version) adds mutation weights and improves discrimination. Favourable lesions include isolated **del 5q** (chromosome 5 loss) and **SF3B1** (splicing mutation) ring sideroblast disease. Adverse lesions include **TP53** (tumour suppressor) double hits, complex karyotypes and **minus 7** (chromosome 7 loss). Risk directs therapy intensity directly.
steps.say: IPSS M adds mutation weights and sharpens risk prediction. Del five q and SF3B1 favour good outcomes. TP53 hits and minus seven mark adverse risk.

steps.tx: Marrow morphology is subtle. **Hypolobated megakaryocytes** (odd platelet mothers), **Pelger Huet anomaly** (bilobed neutrophils) and **ring sideroblasts** (iron granule precursors) flag dysplasia. A **dry tap** (scarce aspirate) signals reticulin fibrosis in some subsets. **Flow cytometry** (antibody cell test) adds immunophenotypic aberrations, while **targeted sequencing** maps the clone in nearly every case. Transfusion dependent anaemia is the dominant burden in low risk disease.
steps.say: Odd megakaryocytes and Pelger Huet neutrophils flag dysplasia. Ring sideroblasts mark specific subsets. Sequencing maps the clone in nearly every patient.

steps.tx: Low risk care is symptom driven. **Iron chelation** follows transfusion iron load, while **ESAs** (erythropoiesis stimulating agents) lift anaemia in erythroid friendly disease. **Luspatercept** (activin trap, TGF beta blocker) boosts red cells in **SF3B1** and ring sideroblast disease with ESA failure. **Lenalidomide** (immunomodulator) cures del 5q anaemia in up to **70** percent. **G-CSF** (granulocyte growth factor) bridges neutropenia, and transfusions remain palliative support.
steps.say: Luspatercept boosts red cells in SF3B1 disease with ESA failure. Lenalidomide cures del five q anaemia in most patients. ESAs lift anaemia in erythroid friendly disease.

steps.tx: High risk disease needs **HMA** (hypomethylating agents, azacitidine or decitabine) as the backbone, with venetoclax added in trials and selected patients. **Ivosidenib** (IDH1 blocker) and **enasidenib** (IDH2 blocker) induce differentiation in mutant disease. **HSCT** (stem cell transplantation) is the sole cure and is offered to fit high risk patients early. **Clinical trials** dominate counselling because standard therapy alone rarely curative.
steps.say: High risk disease needs hypomethylating agents as the backbone. IDH inhibitors induce differentiation in mutant disease. Transplantation is the sole cure for fit high risk patients.

steps.tx: Overlap **MDS MPN** (myelodysplastic myeloproliferative overlap) syndromes blend dysplasia with proliferation. **CMML** (chronic myelomonocytic leukaemia) with monocytosis is the prototype and carries adverse mutations. **Atypical CML** (now MDS MPN with neutrophilia) lacks BCR ABL. **Ring sideroblast MDS MPN with thrombocytosis** (RARS T, platelet disease) carries **JAK2** (kinase mutation) frequently. Management borrows from both MDS and MPN playbooks.
steps.say: CMML blends dysplasia with proliferation and carries adverse mutations. Atypical CML lacks the BCR ABL fusion. Overlap syndromes borrow therapy from both playbooks.

steps.tx: Therapy related disease and inherited predisposition deserve space. **Germline RUNX1** (transcription factor) and **GATA2** (immune transcription) mutations masquerade as sporadic MDS in young patients. Prior **alkylator** (DNA damaging drug) and radiation exposure cause **t-MDS** (therapy related disease). **Donor selection** must exclude germline carriers, since sibling grafts would reintroduce the defect. **Genetic testing** of young adults is now routine.
steps.say: Young patients need germline testing before donor selection. Therapy related disease follows alkylators and radiation. Sibling donors may share the predisposition.

steps.tx: Complications mirror marrow failure. Bleeding follows **thrombocytopenia** (low platelets), infection follows **neutropenia** (low neutrophils) and transfusion needs follow anaemia. **Iron overload** from chronic transfusions injures heart and liver, and chelation follows MDS iron guidelines borrowed from thalassaemia. **Venous thrombosis** (clots) accompanies **JAK2** overlap disease. **Prognosis** (outlook) spans months in adverse disease to normal lifespan in del 5q disease.
steps.say: Bleeding, infection and transfusion dependence dominate low risk disease. Iron overload needs chelation in chronic transfusions. Prognosis spans months to normal lifespan by risk group.

steps.tx: Recent gains reshaped therapy. **Luspatercept** (activin trap) won first line approval in ring sideroblast disease after ESA failure, and **lenalidomide** remains del 5q standard. **Ivosidenib** (IDH1 blocker) and **enasidenib** (IDH2 blocker) offer genotype guided options. **Pevonedistat** (NEDD8 blocker) failed confirmatory trials despite promise. **IPSS M** (molecular score) now replaces cytogenetics alone in labelling algorithms worldwide. Trial referral is the newest standard for high risk disease.
steps.say: Luspatercept won approval after ESA failure in ring sideroblast disease. IPSS M now replaces cytogenetics alone in guidelines. Trial referral is the newest high risk standard.

steps.tx: Exam anchors: blast ceiling **20** percent; commonest cytopenia **anaemia**; favourable lesions del **5q** and **SF3B1** ring sideroblast disease; **lenalidomide** cure rate up to **70** percent in del 5q; **luspatercept** for ring sideroblast disease; **HMA** backbone in high risk; **CMML** as the prototype overlap syndrome; and **HSCT** as the sole cure. Young MDS always prompts germline testing.
steps.say: Blasts below twenty percent separate MDS from leukaemia. Lenalidomide cures del five q anaemia in most patients. Young MDS always prompts germline testing.
